origin.summary: Workout 3 of the 2012 CrossFit Open. The Open is the worldwide online qualifying stage of the CrossFit Games season: one workout released each week, completed and scored by hundreds of thousands of athletes in affiliates and garages on the same few days.

description: An 18-minute AMRAP of box jumps, push press, and toes-to-bar.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/open/2012/3 (official CrossFit Games Open workout), retrieved 2026-07-09
